# Self-Contained Agent Bundle

Auto-generated by `scripts/build-self-contained-bundle.py`.
Each `.md` file in this directory is **fully self-contained**:
all `{file:...}` references have been inlined. Copy a single file
to another project and the agent works — no need for the source
repo layout, no need for the `shared/` directory, no need for the
include resolver.

## Use in any project

```bash
# Copy one or more agents to your target project
cp dist/agents/conductor.md /path/to/your/project/.opencode/agents/
cp dist/agents/builder.md    /path/to/your/project/.opencode/agents/
# ... etc.
```

Or copy the whole bundle:

```bash
cp -r dist/agents/* /path/to/your/project/.opencode/agents/
```

The agent will announce its operating mode (dispatch or single-agent)
on the first response based on whether the env exposes a `task` tool.
